title: Timeouts, Fallbacks and Model Failover
brief: It is a bad afternoon at your model provider: 30% of calls to your primary model come back 529 (overloaded). Your agent waits 30 seconds and tries again, and after three failures on one ticket it gives up. Three support tickets, 20 runs each. Finish at least 90% of them with an average under 18 seconds per ticket.

goals.label: Under 18 seconds per ticket on average

hints: Open a failed ticket in the transcript. How many seconds does each 529 cost, and what happens after the third?
Waiting longer does not help when the provider is overloaded. You need somewhere else to send the call.
Add a Fallback model (medium is fine) and wire the primary model to it. A 529 then costs one quick retry instead of 30 seconds.
explain: An outage you planned for is a slower answer; one you did not plan for is a failed ticket. A fallback model turns a 30-second wait into a 2-second retry somewhere else.
